company_brief_text:
# Unify Consulting () - SVP Technical Pre-Sales and Enterprise Solution Architecture briefing packet

## JD Complement
Unify Consulting is not a product vendor; it is a consulting firm that sells transformation credibility, technical depth, and implementation follow-through. The role likely exists to solve the tension between high-touch advisory selling and
repeatable delivery: turning strategy conversations into scoped, partner-aware, executable programs that can survive enterprise scrutiny.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Unify Consulting’s archetype is hybrid services-led and partner-enabled. It positions itself as an AI management consulting firm that connects strategy, AI, data, and people to drive transformation at scale. The operating model appears to
blend advisory, technical solutioning, and implementation support rather than pure staff augmentation or pure software resale.

The central tension for this role is to make complex enterprise pursuits feel both credible and buildable. That means translating broad transformation intent into concrete architecture, delivery sequencing, and stakeholder alignment without
drifting into generic consulting language.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Verified company signals point to a mid-market consulting firm founded in 2006 and based in Kirkland, with multi-location operations. Public profiles describe business strategy, organizational effectiveness, product management, data
analysis, quality engineering, and security as part of its advisory footprint.

That mix implies pressure to differentiate on technical relevance and execution quality, not just slideware. For a senior pre-sales architecture leader, the decision-rights shift is likely from “what can we recommend?” to “what can we
confidently commit to, package, and hand off?”

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Verified founder information points to Darren Alger. Beyond that, the public record here does not support a fuller named leadership map, so the safer targeting assumption is a compact executive layer with consulting leadership, practice
leads, and client-facing delivery leaders.

Likely stakeholders include:
- Consulting and practice leadership, for pursuit prioritization and margin discipline
- Delivery leadership, for feasibility, staffing, and handoff readiness
- Partner-facing leaders, for cloud and platform alignment
- Client executives, for business case validation and risk reduction

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Unify explicitly centers AI, data, and people in its positioning, which suggests architecture conversations are part of the firm’s value proposition rather than a back-office function. Its solutions page also indicates advanced Salesforce
work for complex industries, including Data Cloud and Experience Cloud.

That matters for this role because the company likely needs solution architects who can bridge:
- AI strategy and enterprise data readiness
- CRM and customer platform modernization
- Security and quality engineering concerns in regulated or complex environments
- Reusable reference patterns that can be adapted across accounts

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Partnership motion is material here. Unify states that it partners with digital and cloud technology leaders to inform strategy and drive implementation, and it has a named Google Cloud partnership focused on data storage, data warehousing,
and visualization with Looker.

This suggests a co-sell and alliance-aware operating style, where technical pre-sales must support partner credibility, joint solution framing, and implementation continuity. The role likely needs to translate vendor roadmaps into
client-specific value and avoid one-off custom designs that cannot be delivered through the ecosystem.

## Recent Events & Urgency
The strongest urgency signal is strategic rather than event-driven: the market is pushing consulting firms to prove AI value, not just AI fluency. For a firm like Unify, that raises the bar on demoability, pilot-to-production pathways, and
measurable business outcomes.

The Google Cloud and Salesforce signals also imply that platform depth is becoming part of the firm’s differentiation. The role likely exists to keep enterprise pursuits anchored in current cloud and data patterns while preserving delivery
realism.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Enterprise pre-sales that converts advisory discovery into executable architecture
- Cloud and data modernization framing for consulting-led pursuits
- Salesforce and adjacent platform solutioning in complex industries
- Partner-aware solution design with implementation continuity
- Executive buyer alignment through business-case and pilot structure
- Reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and delivery handoff discipline
- AI-enabled transformation with practical data and governance constraints

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Lead with the tension between strategy credibility and delivery feasibility
- Reference the need to make AI and data programs concrete enough for enterprise approval
- Mention partner-aware solutioning across cloud and platform ecosystems
- Emphasize pilot design that can survive handoff into delivery
- Signal comfort with complex industry environments and reusable architecture patterns
- Frame the conversation around turning transformation intent into scoped, measurable programs

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph, not from this packet.
